description: Batch09: 80 original bilingual first-pass drafts, 20 per provisional A2/B1/B2/C1; all require independent sense, Myanmar, example, CEFR and real George/Emma listening review. C1 tier is explicitly unsupported.

english_definition_review.task: Independently verify exact dictionary sense and POS; record observed page text, date and reviewer.

burmese_review.task: Independent Burmese editor checks exact sense, naturalness and register.

example_review.task: Independent reviewer checks grammar, collocation and intended sense.

cefr_review.task: Verify sense-specific CEFR from reliable evidence; reclassify or quarantine unsupported tier.

audio_review.task: Only after approval, generate George and Emma word/example audio and actually listen; verify real iPhone Safari.
